% ADDED figure (2026-11-02): the diagrams of one example box (C6a/C6b/§CA.7); generated by qft-C/tools/c6diag/figs/make_figs.sh
\tikzset{
  fdl/.style={line width=0.8pt, black},
  fdx/.style={circle, fill=black, inner sep=0pt, minimum size=3.6pt},
  fdv/.style={circle, fill=figB, draw=figB, inner sep=0pt, minimum size=5pt},
  fdlab/.style={font=\scriptsize, inner sep=2.6pt},
  fdmom/.style={->, >=Stealth, figO, line width=0.6pt},
}
\tikzset{
  fda/.style={fdl, postaction={decorate}, decoration={markings, mark=at position 0.55 with {\arrow{Stealth[length=5pt]}}}},
  fdS/.style={font=\small},
}
\begin{tikzpicture}[font=\small]
  \tikzset{c3/.style={circle, fill=figO, draw=figO, inner sep=0pt, minimum size=5pt}}
  % class (I): cubic vertex carries p_A, p_B
  \newcommand{\dI}[2]{\begin{scope}[xshift=#1cm, yshift=#2cm]
    \draw[fdl] (-0.75,0.6)--(0,0)--(-0.75,-0.6); \draw[fdl] (0,0)--(1.3,0);
    \draw[fdl] (1.3,0)--(2.05,0.65); \draw[fdl] (1.3,0)--(2.2,0); \draw[fdl] (1.3,0)--(2.05,-0.65);
    \node[c3] at (0,0){}; \node[fdv] at (1.3,0){};
    \node[fdlab,left] at (-0.75,0.6){$p_A$}; \node[fdlab,left] at (-0.75,-0.6){$p_B$};
    \node[fdlab,right] at (2.05,0.65){$p_1$}; \node[fdlab,right] at (2.2,0){$p_2$}; \node[fdlab,right] at (2.05,-0.65){$p_3$};
    \node[fdS] at (0.7,-1.15) {$q=p_A+p_B$};
  \end{scope}}
  % class (II): cubic vertex carries p_u (in) and p_i (out)
  \newcommand{\dII}[7]{\begin{scope}[xshift=#1cm, yshift=#2cm]
    \draw[fdl] (0,0.95)--(0.75,0.5)--(1.5,0.95); \draw[fdl] (0.75,0.5)--(0.75,-0.45);
    \draw[fdl] (0,-0.9)--(0.75,-0.45); \draw[fdl] (0.75,-0.45)--(1.55,-0.15); \draw[fdl] (0.75,-0.45)--(1.5,-0.95);
    \node[c3] at (0.75,0.5){}; \node[fdv] at (0.75,-0.45){};
    \node[fdlab,left] at (0,0.95){$p_{#3}$}; \node[fdlab,right] at (1.5,0.95){$p_{#4}$};
    \node[fdlab,left] at (0,-0.9){$p_{#5}$}; \node[fdlab,right] at (1.55,-0.15){$p_{#6}$}; \node[fdlab,right] at (1.5,-0.95){$p_{#7}$};
    \node[fdS] at (0.75,-1.5) {$q=p_{#3}-p_{#4}$};
  \end{scope}}
  % class (III): cubic vertex carries p_j, p_k (both out)
  \newcommand{\dIII}[5]{\begin{scope}[xshift=#1cm, yshift=#2cm]
    \draw[fdl] (-0.3,0.6)--(0.45,0)--(-0.3,-0.6); \draw[fdl] (0.45,0)--(1.3,-0.6); \draw[fdl] (0.45,0)--(1.35,0.5);
    \draw[fdl] (1.35,0.5)--(2.05,0.95); \draw[fdl] (1.35,0.5)--(2.15,0.3);
    \node[fdv] at (0.45,0){}; \node[c3] at (1.35,0.5){};
    \node[fdlab,left] at (-0.3,0.6){$p_A$}; \node[fdlab,left] at (-0.3,-0.6){$p_B$};
    \node[fdlab,right] at (1.3,-0.6){$p_{#3}$}; \node[fdlab,right] at (2.05,0.95){$p_{#4}$}; \node[fdlab,right] at (2.15,0.3){$p_{#5}$};
    \node[fdS] at (0.9,-1.15) {$q=p_{#4}+p_{#5}$};
  \end{scope}}
  % row 1: class I and class III
  \node[fdS,anchor=west] at (-1.3,1.45) {(I) $p_A$, $p_B$ at the cubic vertex: $1$};
  \dI{0}{0}
  \node[fdS,anchor=west] at (5.0,1.45) {(III) two outgoing at the cubic vertex: $3$};
  \dIII{5.6}{0}{1}{2}{3}
  \dIII{9.1}{0}{2}{1}{3}
  \dIII{12.6}{0}{3}{1}{2}
  % rows 2-3: class II
  \node[fdS,anchor=west] at (-1.3,-2.25) {(II) one incoming and one outgoing at the cubic vertex: $2\cdot3=6$};
  \dII{-0.60}{-3.6}{A}{1}{B}{2}{3}
  \dII{2.35}{-3.6}{A}{2}{B}{1}{3}
  \dII{5.30}{-3.6}{A}{3}{B}{1}{2}
  \dII{8.25}{-3.6}{B}{1}{A}{2}{3}
  \dII{11.20}{-3.6}{B}{2}{A}{1}{3}
  \dII{14.15}{-3.6}{B}{3}{A}{1}{2}
  \node[fdS] at (7.0,-5.75) {orange: cubic vertex $-ig$; blue: quartic vertex $-i\lambda$;\quad $1+6+3=10$ diagrams, each $S=1$ ($N_D=144=3!\,4!=|G|$)};
\end{tikzpicture}
